name: Self-Correction / Recovery
runtime_tests: Make a normal verified edit; self_correction.attempted must be false.
Cause an edit to fail on first execution but remain safely applicable; verify one recovery pass and second verification.
Cause a structural replace/delete/move failure; verify recovery refuses to guess and final status remains partial/failed.
Verify recovery never broadens section/element scope.
Verify no second LLM planning call is made by recovery.
Verify additional_credit_cost and additional_ai_calls are both 0.
Verify Luna says Done only when final execution_verification.status is complete.
